# ADR trigger notes — R4.7b (2026-10-22)

Re-homed fired-trigger records (landed ADR bodies are frozen — BM-ADR-01;
precedent 0b3ca91, R4.7a's `2026-10-22-adr-0303-0351-trigger.md`). The
R4.7b run ledger (`docs/build/runs/R4.7b.md`) is the narrative home.

## ADR-0253 — revisit trigger, third clause: FIRED

Trigger text (model-gateway rulings): *"C1 lands the non-static policy
arms, the G-3/G-5/G-6 refusal producers, `probe_profile` and the K2–K6
stores…"* — and the standing condition the build carried into BL-31:
real provider transports and adapters once the hosted/online budget
landed (the Round-4 gate decision authorized it 2026-10-20).

R4.7b lands the adapter half:

- **`crates/hh-embed/src/context_adapters.rs`** — `AdapterLane` (the
  `model_port` `ModelLane` members spelled as adapter coordinates;
  `From<&ModelLane>` carries them verbatim), then:
  - `LaneEmbedder` — `Embedder` over `openai-compatible@1`/`openai@1`
    `POST {endpoint}/embeddings`; i64-ppm quantization of the wire's own
    float lexemes, `index`-ordered batch reassembly, dimension +
    provider-reported model recorded (`EmbedObservation`), provider
    `usage` verbatim. `anthropic-messages@1` refuses `Unsupported` at
    arm — Anthropic publishes no embeddings API (verified
    2026-10-22, platform.claude.com → Build with Claude → Embeddings:
    *"Anthropic does not offer its own embedding model"*).
  - `LaneSummarizer` — `Summarizer` over `GatewayModel`'s one-shot arm
    (the lane's own streaming call; `Error`/`Empty`/`Aborted`/`Overflow`
    mapping per the port contract; `empty_response` → `Empty`; provider
    usage + `model_io_refs` ride `usage`).
  - `LaneProviderCompaction` — `ProviderCompaction` bound to the
    Messages family's on-demand compaction (`compaction:{type:
    "summarize"}` + `anthropic-beta: compact-2026-09-04`). Verified
    2026-10-22 against the provider docs (platform.claude.com → Build
    with Claude → Compaction on demand): response is `stop_reason:
    "compaction"` + one `content[]{type:"compaction", content,
    signature}`; billed counts live under `usage.iterations[type:
    "compaction"]` (top-level input/output are 0 — verified live). The
    `openai` compact endpoint (`POST /responses/compact`) exists but
    answers an *opaque* Responses item — it cannot serve the port's
    `summary_text`, so `openai@1`/`openai-compatible@1` refuse
    `Unsupported` (verified 2026-10-22, developers.openai.com → API
    Guides → Compaction).
- **Boundary wiring** — `KernelContext.adapter_lane` (the armed
  `model_port` lane at open; the manifest's recorded lane re-bound on
  resume) feeds `KernelMemory::run_retrieve` (`Similarity` →
  `LaneEmbedder`) and `KernelCompaction::compact` (`summarize` →
  `LaneSummarizer`, `provider_compaction` → `LaneProviderCompaction`).
  Arm-time typed refusals leave the port unbound — the op's own typed
  `unresolved{…}`/`MissingBody` rows stand; no silent degrade.
- **Live evidence** — `scripts/live-verify.sh context-adapters` record
  `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-context-adapters.json` (pass;
  measured $0.000131 of the $5 allocation): local `LaneSummarizer`
  call real (input 90 / output 37 tokens via the normalized view);
  hosted `openai@1` `text-embedding-3-small` batch real (dim 1536,
  91 input tokens — the recorded `hh-embedding-cache/1` fixture the
  hermetic battery replays); `anthropic-messages@1` compaction real on
  `claude-haiku-5-5` (`stop_reason:compaction`, 127 in / 232 out via
  `iterations`, `forgotten_ids: None`). The local embeddings leg
  answered the provisioned llama.cpp endpoint's own typed refusal —
  *"This server does not support embeddings"* — recorded, not masked
  (the endpoint was started without `--embeddings`; rearming the server
  with the flag or provisioning `HH_LOCAL_EMBED_MODEL` makes the cell
  executable).

## ADR-0313 — revisit trigger (b): FIRED, answered

Trigger text: *"…(b) a provider compaction API reports structured
forgotten ranges — the `all_prior` marker narrows to the reported set
verbatim…"*

Verified 2026-10-22 against the live `compact-2026-09-04` response: the
compaction block carries `{type, content, signature}` — **no structured
forgotten ranges**. `ProviderCompactOutcome.forgotten_ids` stays `None`,
the kernel's `forgotten = {range: all_prior}` leg and lowering-loss
entry apply verbatim — the trigger's narrowing condition does not hold
today; if a provider later reports ranges the marker narrows per the
trigger.

## ADR-0313 — revisit trigger (c): FIRED

*"(c) the hosted/online budget lands a real
`Embedder`/`Summarizer`/`ProviderCompaction` adapter — the port
signatures and refusal spellings stay, the stub leaves the tree."*

Landed by this ticket: the `hh-context` port signatures are untouched
(`Embedder`/`Summarizer`/`ProviderCompaction` unchanged); the typed
refusal spellings stay (`UnresolvedSummarizer`/`MissingBody`/typed
`Unsupported{by}`/`unresolved{embedder}`); the lane-backed
implementations replace the stub wiring wherever a session's armed
`model_port` lane provides the capability — `None`-arm → typed
unresolved stands where no lane exists.

## What R4.7b does NOT do

- No landed ADR body edited (frozen — BM-ADR-01).
- Compaction policy semantics unchanged (ticket's out-of-scope);
  `item_texts`/instruction-text population stays the caller's contract
  (a `summarize` op without bodies still answers `MissingBody`).
- The `openai-compatible@1`/`openai@1` families keep their typed
  `Unsupported` for provider compaction — the capability matrix records
  the verification, not a workaround.
- ADR-0346's live observability-sink leg stays owed on BL-31 — R4.7c.
